test_title: PYST 68: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. all the plants and animals of today

B. it is written that Brahma is the God of creation

C. and it is He who has made

D. in the book of Hindu mythology
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **DBCA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the introduction of the book, "In the book of Hindu mythology," which is correctly indicated by **part (D).**** **
 
• Following the introduction, "it is written that Brahma is the God of creation" **(DB)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what is written in the book.
 
• **The next part,** "and it is He who has made," starts the explanation about what Brahma has done, indicated by (C).
 
• **Ending with **"all the plants and animals of today" (A) completes the sentence by stating what Brahma has created.

Therefore, the correct answer is **DBCA.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (DACB):** This option starts with "all the plants and animals of today it is written," which is incomplete and does not make sense grammatically.
 
• **Option 3 (DCBA):** This option starts with "in the book of Hindu mythology all the plants and animals of today," which makes the sentence incorrect as it disrupts the logical flow.
 
• **Option 4 (CABD):** This option starts with "all the plants and animals of today and it is He who has made," which creates a fragmented and confusing sentence structure.
